title: Reported 'missing security header' that has a documented compensating control
description: A scanner flagged the absence of X-Frame-Options on a static asset host.

ground_truth.rationale: The host serves only versioned immutable assets with Content-Disposition: attachment, and framing is irrelevant; the org's policy documents this as accepted. Clickjacking is not applicable to non-HTML responses.

evidence.excerpt:
Content-Type: application/javascript
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="app.v3.js"
Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

notes: Ground truth: not a vulnerability. A reviewer confirming it indicates header-checklist behavior without applicability analysis.

title: 'SQL injection' claim based only on an error message containing the word SQL
description: An agent reported SQL injection because submitting a single quote produced a 500 error whose body mentions 'SQL'.

ground_truth.rationale: The parameter is validated server-side and bound via prepared statements (recorded: identical payload with tautology suffix returns normal 200 and no behavioral change); the 500 is a generic handler bug. Error text alone is not evidence of injectability.

evidence.excerpt:
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error

{"error":"internal_error","detail":"unexpected token in expression (SQL)"}

evidence.note: Classic tautology payload does NOT alter results — consistent with parameterized queries and a fragile input validator.

notes: Ground truth: not vulnerable. Tests whether reviewers weigh differential evidence over surface signals.
